items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: This guy that ran Birdland, Oscar Goodstein.

ctx.x: Is that what he actually said, on record?

Actually said it. It’s funny. It’s been widely quoted ever since. Leonard was always trying to get out from under, and he kept saying, “Marian, I didn’t . . . I wasn’t really serious. I was joking.” He was protesting . . . I made a lot . . . I had a lot of fun with that, because I don’t remember every feeling daunted by that. As far as a racial thing, I always . . . I don’t know. I just had nothing going on, because all the people, or a good many of the people Jimmy introduced me to, were people like Louis, and…
Several groups. Yeah, I know, sometimes.
